user_request: Three seconds on each calibration point
Repeated rejection after all nine points
Confirm tracking is active during calibration before an exam
findings: Existing preview and calibration worker already execute full Camera.read/analyze before an exam; gaze_enabled represents readiness of the calibrated decision profile, not whether the CNN executes.
Previous capture wrapper discarded failed fit quality and the UI replaced every final reason with a generic message.

Transition observations could fail spread checks despite a stable majority. A fixed longer settling interval excludes the first0.8seconds from every target without fitting or selecting favorable samples.
Exact causes of the three reported physical failures are unknown; previous attempts had no persisted diagnostics.

calibration.quality_gates: Unchanged thresholds, affine fit, independent validation and6degree margin
calibration.selection: Fixed settling window; no quality-driven trimming, no refitting on validation data
calibration.feedback: Fresh accepted gaze sample count and current tracking status; zero counts do not claim active tracking
calibration.diagnostics: Five latest local aggregate JSON reports under application folder/calibration-diagnostics; no images or raw gaze vectors
calibration.failures: Original failure code, failed target, sample counts/spreads, fit/validation metrics and capture rejection counts retained

validation.physical_acceptance: Pending user camera check; no claim that unobserved physical failure is resolved

distribution: Private closed noncommercial hackathon prototype; source and license notices included; no public deploy.
training: No new training or changes on the GPU server/WSL/services.
